creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`FileCardStore.Create` writes without checking whether the file exists, so an ID collision (two cards made in the same 10 ms tick that draw the same 3 random characters) silently replaces an existing card. Rare, but phase 4 starts relying on card IDs being unique.

Design: `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, section "Card creation never overwrites".
title: Never overwrite an existing card file when creating a card
